user_query: I'm planning a trip to Paris with my family and we need some information to make the most of our visit. Can you provide me with news articles about popular tourist attractions in Paris? Additionally, I would like to see relevant images of these attractions to get a better idea of what to expect. Finally, please recommend some good hotels in Paris that are near these attractions.

TaskList.description: Query news articles about popular tourist attractions in Paris.
Fetch relevant images of the tourist attractions identified in step 1.
Recommend hotels in Paris that are located near the attractions identified in step 1.
